name: mf-analyser
description: Excel-driven research analytics platform. Root task runner; mirrors the Makefile.

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && uv sync && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.serve: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run serve
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.lint:frontend: cd frontend && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
